Name: Description
Description: A full description of the purpose for stratifying your sample frame prior to sampling

Name: UniverseReference
Description: Reference each sub universe which defines a strata of the population. For example if you are stratifying on gender there would be 2 Universe references, one to Males and one to Females.

Name: PopulationReference
Description: Reference to each population that defines a stratum of the population being sampled. For example, when stratifying by gender, separate Population references may identify males and females.
